name: Futatsuguri Tamayo
source:
The main heroine of the Fuminari arc. 
Tamayo is set to take over her family's accursed fortune on Sarubotoke Island.
Wise and compassionate, the heiress holds down the fort for her ailing father. Yet, she can't hide her disdain for the curses and sinister ties that bind her family.

"I haven't changed... I've just finally faced the reality."
